data.body: Classification: behavioral (code defect). Fix (two-part): (1) dispatch.py _make_synthetic_error severity 'critical' -> 'important' so synthetic schema_errors are eligible for autonomous resolution / defense rather than hard-blocking PRs. (2) cited_lines frozen-field check now allows range-collapse (e.g. ['x:134','x:138'] -> ['x:134-138']) when corrected entries cover the same line numbers — eliminates the false-positive frozen-field mutation that triggered the synthetic error in the first place. runner.py fail-closed kept as-is to avoid regressing exit-0 slip-through.
